summary: @onereach/idw-contracts preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a TypeScript types and Zod schemas library but declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated with `_0x…` identifiers; it checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary to 0o755, and invokes `bun math_init.js` via execFileSync. The sibling math_init.js is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying a shuffled string-array constant table (`n7gIxM`) rotated by `WV8StW(arr,n)` with hex-named identifiers — a string-array plus rotator obfuscation scheme. math_init.js is not referenced by the declared `main`/`module` entry points (dist/cjs, dist/esm) and is not documented in the README. A pure types/schemas library has no need for a second language runtime or native execution at install time. The delivery shape — install-time fetch of an alternate language runtime purely to execute an opaque bundled payload the Node ecosystem's tooling will not introspect — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern and fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
